notes.title: 2024 Major Update
notes.content:
It's been 2 years since our last update post. Wow. 

[img]https://s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/i.lu.je/2024/Gif9.gif[/img]

We've always known that Poppers was a game brimming with potential, however the realities of the whole development team having day-jobs that have been pretty full-on these last few years meant that Party Poppers had taken a backseat -- and we didn't want to rush it out the door unfinished.

But we're back! We've been working hard in 2024 to polish the game, get the game modes we wanted in, and added a few quality of life features along the way. Check out the new trailer!

[previewyoutube=yoD_y8RRobY;full][/previewyoutube]

Party Poppers finally shows that it is a [strike]popper[/strike] proper evolution of the "Party" series, building upon lessons learned in Party Golf and Party Crashers. There is much more of a focus on simple modifications through the mutators screen, which can now be "locked on" across the variety of different modes. Descriptions are clearer, visible in the scoreboard and pause menu, and the 2D graphics are so much more polished now than our previous titles (with [b]4K support too[/b]!).

[b]We've added AI[/b] so that you can give the game a crack when your friends aren't around. They're better than some of the developers in some modes!

[img]https://s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/i.lu.je/2024/Gif3.gif[/img]

The team have worked hard on filling out all the game modes, curating the mutators, and squashing as many bugs as possible. [b]The game also should now run at a smooth frame rate without slowing down over time[/b].

The game features are the same on PS5 and Steam (minus controller sounds). 

[img]https://s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/i.lu.je/2024/Gif8.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy the update. We plan on launching on Switch later in the year, and any fixes to that will filter on through to Steam too.

Happy Popping!

notes.title: We're Back! Major Party Poppers Update
notes.content:
It has been ages since we last updated the public version of Party Poppers (2019!!), but rest assured, we have been doing weekly test builds for the last 3 months -- and streaming our progress on [url=]https://twitch.tv/utasplay[/url]

We're aiming to release our weekly Steam builds from now on (EVEN while Ian is away on holidays, 100% confirmed).

Pictures speak a thousand words, so check out how different everything looks (and then scroll on for a list of features added):

Main Menu
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cm3cvIg.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Lodevkv.png[/img]

Game Modes
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mu1InLT.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/fGikjlV.png[/img]

Levels
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KZBlhQN.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/HgSsv4q.png[/img]

Mutators
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RbLsA4j.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/GYW5hXG.png[/img]

Level
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IDxfebO.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/qzg8BFj.png[/img]

Another Level
[img]https://i.imgur.com/neYWzKU.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/WZ2lEay.png[/img]

Here is a non-exhaustive list of things we have changed since 2019.
[list]
[*] Extreme graphics improvements
[*] Animated Poppers
[*] More levels (including Arena level)
[*] Top-level game-modes -- Boopmatch and Race
[*] Menu graphics upgrade
[*] Removed references to Party Crashers (images of cars, wording about "tracks" etc)
[/list]

And these game-changing mutators and game modes that completely change they way you play:
[list]
[*] Dashing
[*] Per-Player Balloons
[*] Pushy Balloons (think Rocket League)
[*] Balloon Values / Multipliers
[*] Helium Balloons
[*] Balloon Banks
[*] Tag-Mode (you're "it"!)
[*] Obstacles (spikes, spinny spikey balls)
[*] Domination Zones
[*] Held Balloons
[*] Zones: Gravity, Lava
[*] Respawns, Health, Booping
[*] Skyjunk
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update! 

We'll be at PAXAus this year showing the game, come say hi!
